title: Tier attestation and selection

tiers_clause.doc: Name of the Tiers clause in the parent Agreement.

initial.doc: Tier in effect before any selection.

effective.doc: When an acknowledged selection takes effect.

UP:Tier-Selection/selects.doc: The Member attests that it meets the conditions of the named tier, stating the basis.

render: The Member's tier is {{initial}} until changed under this clause. The Member may attest that it meets the conditions of another tier, stating the basis. The change takes effect when the Supplier acknowledges the attestation, {{effective|effective}}.
